brief.text: Max Dowman is the story of the morning, and every outlet from the BBC to Sky is singing the same tune: Arteta is open to a January loan "in the right circumstances", while calling the teenager extraordinary and admitting the club can no longer hide him in the shadows. File that firmly under Rumour, though, because a manager saying "maybe, one day" is a long way from a Here We Go, and Dowman is still off to England youth duty this break regardless. Elsewhere, Arteta expects a new Arsenal contract to get done (again, expectation rather than ink), he declined to reignite the Hurzeler spat ahead of the Brighton crunch, and five players were missing from training pictures, so keep an eye on the team news. Off the pitch, Thierry Henry has landed a new gig alongside Kylian Mbappe, and Enzo Maresca has thrown a title-race dig in Arteta's direction, which is exactly the sort of noise a Gooner can enjoy ignoring.
